title: Who Ate the Disk?
story: Disk alerts again. This time the culprit is a single huge file hiding somewhere under /var.
goal: Find the largest file under /var/data and report its full path.
hints: du -a lists every file with its size.
Sort the sizes with sort -h or -n, and look at the biggest.

Run:
du -a /var/data
du -a /var/data | sort -n
Then answer: /var/data/b/old/backup.tar
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
